scope: Official FX-Clover blog text for the first seven P0 curriculum posts. Embedded video details are not inferred when the video transcript/content is unavailable.

sources.title: GWで要点を覚える 【FXポコニカルマスター講座スタート】するよ！

claims.claim: The author explicitly says Poconical had evolved since its start and that this course was a 2021-version consolidation.

The author recommends learning through the study-session sequence because knowing the method alone is insufficient; repeated examples are used to compare judgments, stacked evidence and recurring chart behavior.
The author requires prerequisite/basic material before the master course and describes Poconical as grounded in repeated basics rather than an isolated entry trick.
The author emphasizes building one's own validated data and discretion through repeated chart review rather than accepting second-hand rules without verification.

sources.automation_impact: Preserve chronology and evidence stacking. Do not reduce the method to a single indicator/candle trigger. Research proxies require project validation even when their underlying concept is official.

sources.title: FXポコニカルマスター講座① 苦行ウィークの始まりです（笑）

claims.claim: The official course outline describes Poconical as always targeting a formation right-shoulder area.
The official course outline explicitly identifies moving averages and Granville's law as important Poconical components.
The assigned supporting material includes W-top right-shoulder, trend-pattern, MA basics and Granville study, reinforcing that the entry concept is learned together with context.

sources.automation_impact: Strengthens the right-shoulder concept and MA/Granville context. The blog text does not define a swing algorithm, lower-shoulder tolerance, MA distance threshold or exact AND/OR trigger set.
still_unresolved: Exact machine definition of right shoulder
Exact parameter values when not independently grounded by another primary source

sources.title: FXポコニカルマスター講座②【環境認識はゾーンにお任せ♥】

claims.claim: The official course outline teaches environment recognition using zones together with Fibonacci retracement.
The course includes zone drawing, timeframe-specific zone coloring and zone usage as part of environment recognition.
The assigned homework includes 75MA and 200MA usage, reinforcing that environment work is not isolated from MA context.

sources.automation_impact: Strongly supports `upper_environment_valid` as a real official concept, but the blog text does not provide a universal algorithm for zone boundaries, timeframe weighting or numeric validity thresholds.

sources.title: FXポコニカルマスター講座③【エントリーはお告げから♥】

claims.claim: The official course explicitly covers entry conditions and pre-entry chart cues ('お告げ') as a dedicated topic.
Assigned material includes Dow theory, a beginner-friendly entry area focused away from the absolute head/tail, and stop placement tied to a clear sign/escape concept.

sources.automation_impact: The blog page proves that specific entry-condition teaching exists but does not state the detailed machine condition. Do not infer a numeric trigger or redefine current TRIGGER logic from the topic label alone.
still_unresolved: Exact definition of the pre-entry cue
Exact stop rule taught inside the course video

sources.title: FXポコニカルマスター講座④【Wフォーメーションの重要性①+④ゾーン】

claims.claim: The official course explicitly treats W-formation importance, right-shoulder interpretation and line interpretation as core topics.
Assigned material links formation concentration, stretched-range entry patterns, MA/rate interaction and no-trade/low-value locations to this course stage.

sources.automation_impact: Further grounds right-shoulder/formations as core concepts. Exact swing tolerances, line rules and the meaning of 1+4 zones require video/source-level detail and remain non-production.

sources.title: FXポコニカルマスター講座⑤【手法の使い分けと相場で生きるという事】

claims.claim: The official final course explicitly covers simple method/setup selection rather than presenting one universal entry for all market states.
The assigned material includes avoidance of marginal entries, risk/capital management, 200MA/600MA trade patterns and verification practice.
The author states that completing courses 0-5 is the beginning of the real learning process, with continued output and validation required.

sources.automation_impact: Supports context-dependent setup selection and continued validation. It does not justify a universal machine threshold for MA obstacles, room, or setup selection from the blog text alone.

sources.title: FXポコニカルマスター講座【補足】ちょっと細かい話

claims.claim: The supplement explicitly covers fine-grained entry, DiNapoli 3-3, exit details and the idea that one's own axis includes having one's own definitions.
The author describes 3-3 as a final discriminator among multiple pieces of evidence, while also explicitly stating that it can be omitted and is a matter of preference.
The author describes Poconical learning as pattern recognition strengthened by repeated verification and accumulated data.

sources.automation_impact: Important chronology/design distinction: DMA3-3 is officially used and can be a final discriminator, but this source directly argues against labeling 3-3 as a universally mandatory Poconical component. Current system use of 3-3 remains an explicit project design choice unless stronger contradictory primary evidence is found.
still_unresolved: Fine-grained entry condition from the supplement video
Fine-grained exit condition from the supplement video
How optional 3-3 is combined with alternative evidence in every setup

production_policy: No new numeric READY/TRIGGER threshold is justified by this blog-text batch. Video-level details or stronger primary text must be reviewed before any machine rule promotion.
